newsitem.title: BELGIUM: COMMISSION TO HEAR DI RUPO AT 1900 -- RADIO.
newsitem.headline: COMMISSION TO HEAR DI RUPO AT 1900 -- RADIO.

text.p: The special parliamentary commission investigating allegations that Deputy Prime Minister Elio Di Rupo had sex with under-age boys, is due to hear the minister when it reconvenes at 1900 (1800 GMT), Belgian radio said on Wednesday.

The commission has to decide whether the evidence is strong enough to warrant recommending to the full Belgian parliament to lift Di Rupo's immunity from prosecution and send him before the Cour de Cassation, the country's highest court.
